notes: Summary: SparrowByte builds a JetBrains plugin (IntelliJ/PyCharm) that does local indexing of the user's repo and hybrid inference: small context completions run locally or in private cluster, larger context or heavy ops routed to Dedicated in-region capacity. Key ask: sub-50ms per-token streaming for interactive completions, 95th pct under 100ms for common code paths. CTO Priya: 'We cannot allow raw source to leave our VPC unless encrypted and consented per repo.' Wants model/version pinning so completions are deterministic across teams and for audits. POC scope: integrate Redwood SDK into existing plugin, validate local index hits reduce tokens sent, test fallback routing when developer machine is offline, measure latency for 128/512 token scenarios. Security: require SSO/SAML, audit logging for tokens and prompts, KMS-managed keys for any persisted cache, SOC2/ISO27001 proof. Perf questions: quantized model quality vs latency trade-offs (we need recommendations from Optimize). Business: small license per-seat + Dedicated capacity for CI and heavier completion workloads. Timeline: aiming to finish POC and security review by end of Oct.
